taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Ruby YAML loader mode, permitted classes and object construction trust
controls.source_trace: Follow lower-trust YAML through the actual loader configuration and determine whether arbitrary constructors or authority-bearing object state are accepted.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve Psych/Ruby version, safe_load/unsafe_load/load behavior, permitted classes and aliases at the actual callsite. Do not assume every YAML loader constructs arbitrary objects or every permitted class is dangerous. Use a harmless custom fixture class only in an isolated harness, trace reachable callbacks, and avoid executing untrusted deserialization gadgets.
controls.operational_method: Retain loaded Psych gem version, actual method owner/implementation and safe_load/load/unsafe_load arguments, including permitted classes/aliases. Ruby version alone can be insufficient when the gem or wrapper differs. Trace the permitted class construction/callback and downstream use in source before selecting a harmless isolated fixture class. A generic YAML parse success or an old reference version does not demonstrate object execution in the installed loader.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated fixture with primitive data and an inert custom class; compare allowed plain data and rejected unexpected object construction.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: YAML parsing itself is not unsafe object loading; a safe loader rejecting the test type disproves that specific path.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use context-appropriate safe loading and explicit data validation, retesting valid aliases/types required by the feature.
